resources.string: No wayland windows yet\n(start a Wayland app in the container)
When the soft keyboard opens, the wayland window:
Inset (surface shrinks above the keyboard, client reflows)
Overlay (keyboard floats over the window, surface unchanged)
Display zoom (whole wayland window, applies immediately):
Window scaling (when a fixed-size window is resized, applies immediately):
Auto attach (daemon launches the host window automatically when a wayland window is created; off = the window waits for a binder SURFACE from its app):
Stretch (fill the window, aspect may distort)
Scale XWayland windows with display zoom :
Initial window size (first-frame placeholder before Android sizes the window, applies to new windows):
Compositor backend (on = SC/HWC: wayland layers are composed by SurfaceFlinger, zero-copy scanout when possible; off = per-window GL renderer fallback. Applies to windows attached from now on):

Configure serial (on = allocate a fresh wayland serial for every configure; Qt/KDE wayland clients ignore the serial-0 configure a daemon without prior input otherwise sends, leaving the first app without a window. Off = legacy behaviour):
This daemon does not know this option — rebuild the module from this source tree to enable it.

Touchpad (use the window as a laptop pad: one finger moves the pointer, a tap clicks, long-press then drag drags, two fingers scroll, a two-finger tap right-clicks. The "Pad" key on the key bar switches between this and direct touch while the window is open; this setting is the mode a window opens in):

Shortcut key bar, two rows (Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Super latch: tap to hold, tap again to release; plus Esc, Tab, arrows, Enter and Backspace). The keyboard key summons the IME, Pad switches between touchpad and direct touch, and the gear opens the settings screen. Applies to windows opened from now on):

Edge inset (keep a band the height of the status bar clear on the window\'s long axis — top and bottom in portrait, left and right in landscape — so the client\'s own toolbar and the panel\'s rounded corners do not overlap. Applies to windows opened from now on):
How the Linux canvas maps onto the panel. On a fixed screen "sharp", "complete" and "magnified" cannot all hold at once — a 1.5x view can only show 848 of 1272 pixels:
Exact (1:1, sharpest, never cropped — zoom has no effect)
Follow window with zoom (UI grows; wide windows clip at the edge)
Whole desktop 1920x1080 (scaled to fit with letterbox, never cropped)
